scope: Recorded pre-commit archive verification and visual design review. CI verifies the verbatim prompt and this source-bound review; CI does not pretend to possess or rehash the original raster files. The supplied ZIP is retained with the final chat delivery.

reference_comparison.review: Grouped vector/native tools, paper settings always visible, actual project tree, centered vector sheet and collapsible inspector match the reference hierarchy.
intentional_differences: Existing CWS product navigation retained, not replaced by fictitious reference navigation.
Paper content comes from imported geometry and its actual scale, not the fictitious plate or dimensions.
Review/blocked state remains visibly amber; no fixed PASS badge.
Long status is explicitly elided with full tooltip/accessibility text; per-issue text remains in Linter.

reference_comparison.review: Real anchors and selection grips are rendered by the drawing canvas. Inline native fields edit persisted dimension transactions; nominal measurement and component IDs remain unchanged by formatting.
intentional_differences: Properties use grouped tree sections with vertical scrolling rather than a second floating dialog.
Mixed selections retain each unrelated property.
No fictitious DWG or hardcoded 1250 mm text.

reference_comparison.review: Actual STEP component identities are retained in assembly dimensions. Model tree, BOM, revision and linter projections use the active project. Saved dimensions are compared in an independent process.
intentional_differences: BOM/Linter/Revisions are context tabs to preserve drawing space.
Independent process success is evidence, not an unconditional in-app banner.
A mesh-based assembly remains review-only where exact assembly BREP/Trusted authority is unavailable; it never falls back to a single part.
